title: Loose wheel, loose axle
odia:
ଚକ ଢିଲାକୁ ଅଖ ଢିଲା
ଯାଉ ଯାଉ ଗାଡି ଯୁଆଡେ ଗଲା।
literal_meaning: The wheel is loose and the axle loose; as it goes along, the cart goes whichever way.
meaning_odia: ଚକ ଓ ଅଖ ଦୁହେଁ ଢିଲା ଥିବାରୁ ଗାଡ଼ିର ଗତି ଠିକ୍ ରହୁନାହିଁ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ପରସ୍ପର ସହ ଜଡ଼ିତ କାମର ଏକାଧିକ ଅଂଶରେ ଶୈଥିଲ୍ୟ ରହିଲେ ସମଗ୍ର କାମ ଅନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଯିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଏହା।
explanation: The trouble is shared by two connected parts: neither wheel nor axle is firm. The cart’s direction then becomes uncertain. Read editorially, the image describes what happens when laxness is present in more than one part of a shared undertaking and nobody supplies the needed steadiness.
usage_example: Original imagined example: One team leaves the instructions vague, while another carries them out without checking. As the work drifts from its purpose, a colleague recalls the loose wheel and axle.
cultural_context: The verse moves from the wheel and axle to the whole cart. That change of scale gives the image its force: weaknesses in connected parts affect the direction of the undertaking as a whole.
